description.p: SoloKeys GUI is a desktop application for managing Solo 2 security keys. It can inspect connected devices, manage FIDO2 resident credentials and PIN state, install firmware updates, and expose PIV, OpenPGP, Secrets, and administrative workflows when the device and host support them.
The Flatpak build requires access to Solo 2 USB/HID devices for FIDO2, discovery, and firmware flashing. PIV and OpenPGP features require the host PC/SC service to be available.
Browser native messaging integration is not available in the Flatpak build yet. Use the native Linux packages or AppImage if you need SoloKeys Vault browser integration.
